Common questions

How much do the webinars cost?

Nothing. Every session in the series is free and held live online via Zoom, with open Q&A at the end.

How often are the webinars?

A new session runs every other Thursday, 5:00-6:00 PM Mountain. Each one covers a different federal retirement topic, so you can attend just the ones you need or follow the whole series.

Do I have to be close to retirement to attend?

No. The series is designed for federal employees at any stage. The earlier you understand your benefits and your numbers, the more options you have - so it is worth attending well before you plan to retire.

Will I be sold financial products on the webinar?

No. These are educational sessions with no high-pressure pitch. Ann teaches the material and answers your questions; if you want a personal review afterward, you can request one, but it is never required.

Can I watch past webinars I missed?

Yes. Recorded sessions are posted on this page as replays you can watch any time.

Can my spouse attend with me?

Absolutely - spouses are welcome and encouraged. You can watch together from one device or each register for your own link.
